selection: design sample of the calculator view for the PV lifetime balance page: three components, everything that depends on the initial phrase defined by triples
description: The machine readable form of docs/llm/new_view_sample_pv_balance.md, not imported by any test: the component types and the calculator keyword triples do not exist yet. The system part (the words, the triples with a code_id, the components, the views and the view relation) belongs to a system file calculator_keywords.json, the use case part (the triples without a code_id) to pv_lifetime_balance.json. The use case part prefers general triples of the phrases (labels, hints, highlights, side results and selector options that are true wherever a calculator shows the phrase) and keeps only the lists, their order and the texts that need the page as triples of the page phrase. A label or hint is the description of a triple from the item or from its phrase to the calculator label or calculator hint keyword; without one the item shows the phrase name, or for a row built from the group phrase the label or name of the other phrase. The order of a list is a chain of order triples: each item except the first is follower of the item before.

words.name: calculator
words.description: a page that calculates results from the inputs of the user for one initial phrase e.g. a PV installation

words.name: hint
words.description: a short help text shown next to or below a label

words.name: highlight
words.description: a mark that makes an item stand out e.g. a key row of a result table

words.name: sign
words.description: whether a number is positive or negative

triples.name: zukunft.com system
triples.description: keyword for system internal triples such as the column definitions

triples.name: calculator (system)
triples.description: keyword of the calculator view; a phrase that can be a calculator gets its page by the triples of the keywords below

triples.name: calculator label
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from an item or from a phrase to this keyword is the label of the item e.g. the page title, a heading, a field label, a column header or a row label; the label of the item wins over the label of its phrase

triples.name: calculator hint
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from an item or from a phrase to this keyword is the hint of the item e.g. the lead text or the sub text of a row; the hint of the item wins over the hint of its phrase

triples.name: calculator input
triples.description: list: the items of the group triple to this keyword are the input fields

triples.name: calculator assumption
triples.description: list: the assumptions shown first and with a label; the other operands follow sorted by label

triples.name: calculator result column
triples.description: list: the column phrases of the main result table

triples.name: calculator row group
triples.description: list of lists: the row groups of the main result table, each with its rows; a row has with filters, and its side results are the has a triples of the row phrase or the filter phrase

triples.name: calculator detail table
triples.description: list: the detail tables, each with its columns (has a) and its extra rows (with)

triples.name: calculator highlight
triples.description: flag: an item, or a phrase on every page, with a triple to this keyword is shown as a key row

triples.name: calculator signed
triples.description: flag: the cells of a row group with a triple to this keyword show the sign of the number

components.name: title calculator
components.description: the calculator label of the page phrase, or of the phrase it is built from, as the page title and its calculator hint as the lead text

components.name: calculator input
components.description: the input fields of the calculator input items, the refresh button and the assumptions in a collapsed block

components.name: calculation result
components.description: the main result table by the column and row group items, then the detail tables, the formula notes and the sources in a collapsed block

components.name: title calculator editor
components.description: the title of the editor with the calculator label and a link back to the calculator page

components.name: calculator setting tree
components.description: one table per calculator keyword with the items of the calculator in their order: up and down links that change the order triples, phrase, label and hint of the item with the general label and hint of the phrase as placeholder, remove and an empty row to add an item

components.name: calculator label list
components.description: all label and hint triples of the calculator and of the phrases of its items in one table, selected by the calculator label and calculator hint parent; a label of a phrase is marked, because a change of it changes every calculator that lists the phrase

components.name: calculator field settings
components.description: the general triples and values of every phrase of the calculator: the field triples of the input and assumption phrases incl. the selector options and the highlights and side results of the row phrases, which change every page that uses the phrase

components.name: calculator derived parts
components.description: read only: the derived assumptions, notes and sources with links to their editors

components.name: calculator editor save
components.description: the form of the editor that shows the editor again with the changes

views.name: Calculator
views.description: the inputs and the results of one initial phrase e.g. a PV installation; what the page shows is defined by the calculator triples of the phrase and the general calculator triples of the listed phrases

views.name: Calculator editor
views.description: change the calculator triples of a phrase: the inputs, the assumptions, the columns, the rows, the detail tables, the labels and the hints
